title: DevMate
tagline: DevMate: Find your dream hack team, and turn your ideas into winning innovations!
description:
DevMate revolutionizes the hackathon experience, providing a dynamic platform for hackers to forge powerful collaborations. Upon joining, hackers craft detailed profiles, outlining their skills, interests, and aspirations. Through advanced algorithms, DevMate pairs them with like-minded individuals, forming formidable teams poised for success.

Upon completing their hack, participants seamlessly submit their projects onto the platform. Here's where DevMate truly sets itself apart: every project and individual's role is immortalized within their on-chain profile, offering an indelible testament to their accomplishments. Additionally, DevMate emphasizes camaraderie by allowing participants to bestow rewards upon their teammates, fostering a culture of mutual respect and recognition.
how_its_made:
We have used React, React Native (Mobile App) and Tailwind CSS for FE Development. We have deployed a contract on Scroll and Mantle and have also used Gnosis Safe for wallet integration. 

The partner tech we used was Gnosis Safe, Mantle and Scroll, these were relatively easy to deploy and the docs were easy to understand and follow through.
